name: discover_skills
description:
Browse or search the skill catalog. Skills are SKILL.md recipes for using Emi's tools to accomplish specific tasks (e.g. 'image-resize', 'github', 'sandboxed-python-execution'). Returns headers (name + description + auto-inject keywords) — call read_skill to load the full body of one.

DO NOT call defensively as a first step. Relevant skills auto-inject into your prompt when keywords match the task — if you can already see a skill block that covers the task, proceed with it directly. Only call this tool when no relevant skill appears in your prompt AND you suspect one might exist.

Examples of legitimate use:
- Task uses uncommon phrasing that wouldn't trigger keyword auto-inject (e.g. "convert this PNG to fit a thumbnail" → query='image resize')
- No skill block visible in your prompt but the task feels like it should have a recipe
- Browsing what exists at the start of a new domain you haven't worked in before

Pairs with read_skill the way pod_search pairs with pod_fetch.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Intent or keywords matched against skill names and descriptions. Omit for a browse of all registered skills (sorted alphabetically).

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: Max skills to return. Default 5, max 50.

outputs.description: Numbered list of matching skills with name, description, and auto-inject keywords.
Structured: {query, mode ('search'|'browse'), count, total_available, skills: [{name, description, auto_inject_keywords}]}.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments for discover_skills:
- query (optional): intent or keywords. Omit to browse.
- limit (optional): default 5, max 50.
Example: {"query": "resize image", "limit": 5}

metadata.planner_description: Browse or search the skill catalog (SKILL.md recipes for using Emi's tools). Headers only — call read_skill for full body.
